# Ahmed Rabea

> Senior Brand Designer & Art Director, based in Cairo. Brand identity, design systems, social and campaign systems, presentation design and creative direction, in English and Arabic, for companies in the Gulf. Takes on select freelance projects. Arabic summary page: https://a-rabea.github.io/ar/.

## Pages
- [Home](https://a-rabea.github.io/): selected work and about
- [Services](https://a-rabea.github.io/services/): services, ways to start and enquiry form

## Case studies
- [mazeed](https://a-rabea.github.io/work/mazeed/): Brand system and campaigns. Visual direction and design system for a B2B accounting platform serving 1,000+ clients across the UAE and KSA.
- [AYWA](https://a-rabea.github.io/work/aywa/): Brand identity for a fintech app (self-initiated). An identity concept for a card and money app aimed at Egypt's 16 to 28 year olds. Aywa is the loud Egyptian yes.
- [VULT](https://a-rabea.github.io/work/vult/): Brand identity and packaging (self-initiated). An Arabic identity concept for an energy drink named after a unit of voltage.
- [Aureya](https://a-rabea.github.io/work/aureya/): Brand world and social campaign. A bilingual brand world and weekly social system for a luxury skincare house in Saudi Arabia.
- [Ideas that scale](https://a-rabea.github.io/work/ideas-that-scale/): Social media systems. Social systems for nine brands: one idea, a few hard rules, scaled across formats, languages and markets.
- [Sheikh Khalifa Hospital](https://a-rabea.github.io/work/sheikh-khalifa-hospital/): Company profile design. A company profile redesign for a specialist hospital on the UAE's East Coast.
- [roava](https://a-rabea.github.io/work/roava/): Brand identity and packaging (self-initiated). A specialty coffee brand concept that is calm and loud at once: soft lavender, broken by one lime accent.
- [Qinwan](https://a-rabea.github.io/work/qinwan/): Brand identity and company profile (self-initiated). A brand identity and 31-page company profile for an imagined family house of dates and coffee.
- [Pizza Rush](https://a-rabea.github.io/work/pizza-rush/): Brand identity and mascot (self-initiated). A loud, fast pizza brand rebuilt from an old project of mine, with a mascot called Rushu.
